The '''South Sector Boppers''' were a [[Band/Legends|band]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era. Sometime around [[3643 BBY]], they played in the [[Slippery Slopes Cantina]] in [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] [[Promenade]] with the following lineup: one [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] singer, one male Twi'lek [[strummer]], four [[Kloo horn/Legends|Kloo]] players&mdash;two [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] or [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] and two [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]]&mdash;and a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Nalargon/Legends|nalargonist]].

Their repertoire appears to have included popular [[Music/Legends|songs]] of the day such as ''[[Shapa Keesay]]'', ''[[Doe Azalus Ootmian]]'', ''[[Smeeleeya Whao Tupee Upee]]'', ''[[Kayfoundo Naweea]]'', as well as classic [[yerk]] instrumental pieces like ''[[Run Kessel Run]]'' and ''[[Average Brown Wookiee]]''.
